post.description:
create a root analysis for a code version. Returns the created analysis, or the
colliding candidates when an equivalent analysis already exists (fork one of them to proceed)

get.description: list analyses using various search parameters. Returns a paginated response.
get the most recent HEAD version with expanded findings information. Returns `exists: false` when the team has no matching analysis

post.description: merge a version into an existing lineage, resolving a create-time collision

get.description: retrieve a specific analysis by ID, including its current HEAD version

patch.description: update analysis metadata. Returns a boolean, as the HEAD cannot be resolved without an environment

delete.description: soft delete an analysis and every version in its lineage

get.description: list analysis versions using search parameters. Returns a paginated response.
retrieve a specific analysis version by ID

delete.description: delete an analysis version. Returns the full analysis, since the HEAD may move.

post.description:
create a child version of an analysis. Returns the full analysis, since the HEAD moves.
When an equivalent version already exists, returns the colliding candidates to merge instead

get.description: retrieve the entrypoints in scope for an analysis version
retrieve every finding on an analysis version, committed and staged. Not paginated.
diff the staged (uncommitted) finding changes against the version's committed findings
diff a version's findings against its parent version

post.description: fork a version into an analysis you own, making it your own root
point the analysis HEAD at this version
apply the staged finding changes to the version. Returns the full analysis, since the HEAD moves.
queue the security pipeline for the entrypoints in scope on this version
requeue the failed entrypoints of a version. Retries are not counted against usage limits.
create a chat thread scoped to an analysis version

get.description: list analysis chat threads using search params. Returns a paginated response.

post.description: send a message to a chat thread and receive the complete response as JSON (non-streaming)

send a message to a chat thread and receive a streamed response.
Authenticated by the single-use `stream_key` query param rather than a bearer token

get.description: retrieve a specific chat thread
retrieve the messages of a chat thread, oldest first
list findings using search parameters. Returns a paginated response.

post.description: stage one or more new findings on an analysis version. Changes are not applied until the version is committed.

get.description: retrieve a specific finding by ID, including the actions available to the caller

patch.description: stage an edit to a finding. Changes are not applied until the version is committed.

delete.description: stage the deletion of a finding. Changes are not applied until the version is committed.

post.description: discard the staged changes on a finding. Returns `exists: false` when reverting removed a staged addition outright.

patch.description: acknowledge or unacknowledge a finding without changing its content

get.description: retrieve the comment thread on a finding

post.description: add a comment to a finding. Referenced users are notified.

get.description: retrieve analysis activity broken down by user, optionally scoped to a project
retrieve the finding trend over time for a project
retrieve the finding breakdown by network for a project
list remediations using search parameters. Returns a paginated response.
retrieve a specific remediation by ID
